header.description: (Required) Identifies a unique entity for transaction processing at the lowest level of the account hierarchy of the backend proprietary merchant acquiring processing platform. This level organizes transaction types for submission, funding, and reporting.

A unique key produced by the initial entry of a customer by the originating source system, that will provide a linkage between independent events. This will allow events from multiple applications to be linked together to represent a single string of events or a customer contact experience. This field should be considered generic (aka ability to use for document event tracking) to allow correlation of events not specific to customer contacts. This is unique per customer experience and should be passed between applications.
Unique request identifier to track the request through application programming interface(API) .
The identifier (id) of the user who created the object or inserted the row. This could be the Firm’s Standard Identifier, or the identifier of a batch/functional process.
Identifies a unique occurrence of an application which can be a combination of in-house-developed software and/or vendor products that are designed to process, store or transmit the Firm's data.

header.description: (Required) Identifies a unique entity for transaction processing at the lowest level of the account hierarchy of the backend proprietary merchant acquiring processing platform. This level organizes transaction types for submission, funding, and reporting.

A unique key produced by the initial entry of a customer by the originating source system, that will provide a linkage between independent events. This will allow events from multiple applications to be linked together to represent a single string of events or a customer contact experience. This field should be considered generic (aka ability to use for document event tracking) to allow correlation of events not specific to customer contacts. This is unique per customer experience and should be passed between applications.
Unique request identifier to track the request through application programming interface(API) .
The identifier (id) of the user who created the object or inserted the row. This could be the Firm’s Standard Identifier, or the identifier of a batch/functional process.
Identifies a unique occurrence of an application which can be a combination of in-house-developed software and/or vendor products that are designed to process, store or transmit the Firm's data.

This will allow events from multiple applications to be linked together to represent a single string of events or a customer contact experience. This field should be considered generic (aka ability to use for document event tracking) to allow correlation of events not specific to customer contacts. This is unique per customer experience and should be passed between applications.
Unique request identifier to track the request through application programming interface(API) .
Identifies a unique occurrence of an application which can be a combination of in-house-developed software and/or vendor products that are designed to process, store or transmit the Firm's data.
(Required) This is used for specifying FileName of the Bulk Import File.
(Required) This is used for specifying Submitter Id of the Bulk Import File.
